messages:
maya: Quick Q — where do I find p95/p99 and TTFT for Dedicated clusters? Trying to tune alerts before tomorrow's deploy.

sam: Grafana -> Cluster Latency / Inference -> panel 'Time to first token by model (p50/p95/p99)'. Link: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/inf-latency (use 5m window).

liam: if you want a quick PromQL to get p95 over 5m:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
but note TTFT uses `inference_time_to_first_token_seconds` (histogram) not request_duration.

zara: tokens/sec is `rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])`. Panel name: 'Token throughput (tokens/sec)'. Check the dashboard's top-right selector (1m/5m) — 1m is noisy.

maya: sweet — are alert thresholds set on p95 for TTFT currently? I saw a flurry of p95 alerts last week.

sam: alerts live in Alertmanager. Current prod rule: `TTFT_p95 > 0.6` for 5m -> pages. It's noisy on cold cache; we should either increase window or add warmup suppression.

liam: proposal: change rule to `for: 15m` and exclude `cache_hit=true` (ie only alert on cold path). Also consider tying to tokens/sec baseline so we don't page during low-volume spikes.

maya: can someone file the alert tweak? I'm out tomorrow morning.

zara: I'll open the PR updating the rule + a note on rationale and metrics screenshots. @ops-bot can you silence the current paging for that alert for 60m while we roll?

ops-bot: Done — alertmanager silence created for `TTFT p95` by zara for 60m :white_check_mark:

sam: For traces, use Jaeger -> service=runtime-inference, search span `time_to_first_token`. Increase sampling to 100% for the short window if you need full traces; otherwise use trace ids from failing requests.

maya: thanks. If I run a local repro, which header forces the cold path? Any quick curl to paste?

liam: set header `X-Cache-Mode: miss` and run:
```
curl -H "X-Cache-Mode: miss" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
That forces no prefix/KV cache. Watch `inference_time_to_first_token_seconds` on the dashboard.

zara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/894 — includes rule change + screenshots. Will deploy canary in 10m and report. :eyes: 

maya: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
